game_concept: A survival strategy set in Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit, the roaring summit: the volcanologist must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Arithmetic Cannon: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on fire sprites.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Pyre Summit: the roaring summit
core_gameplay_loop: In Pyre Summit, repeat each round: Choose +, -, *, / or // to build a damage formula that exactly matches a shield number on fire sprites. Each round, fire sprites strike the obsidian gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the damage value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the obsidian gate from fire sprites in Pyre Summit: keep the damage meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 67-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: damage drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 67-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Arithmetic Cannon
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Arithmetic Cannon' (Week 2 slot 2), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Pyre Summit'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how damage changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Pyre Summit.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 67 seconds while damage > 0.
